template.source: Overload · Adrien batch 01 · 1:1 wojak vs chad meme (Wildhorn c0310 validated)
template.production_method: collage — meme line-art (crying wojak / chad) on a white vs red split, three caps lines each side, product cut-out bottom right, all text by script

decode.scroll_stop_trick: The crying wojak and the bearded chad — the internet's own 'loser vs winner' — with three brutally specific bedroom lines under each; the reader knows which one he is.
decode.hidden_reading: explicit sexual humiliation vs triumph, the wife as witness — ours: belly shame with the wife as the same witness, same profanity level
decode.scene_logic: no scene; a meme card. Ours: same card, same two faces, belly lines instead of bedroom lines
decode.visual_trick: two meme faces facing each other across a white/red split, product tucked bottom right, 'ingredient stack' line bottom left — copy literally; red half → Edenvia accent blue
decode.shape_or_function_equivalent: none needed (meme faces stay meme faces); the chad gets a flat tucked-in shirt line in the drawing, the wojak a round belly line
decode.shock_level: shocking / crude — match it ('holy shit' stays)
decode.render_style: black line-art meme faces, flat white left half, flat red → Edenvia blue #1468DB right half
decode.text_treatment: heavy condensed black caps (Oswald-like) in 3 short blocks per side, bottom-left big caps ingredient line + regular tagline, red CTA button 'SHOP NOW →' → blue

strategy.angle: A8-M the man's belly that isn't fat — he sucks it in, the other one tucks his shirt in
strategy.mechanism: M1: when the body can't clear everyday oxidative stress, the tissue in the legs stays inflamed and stops draining normally, so fluid sits there — heavy, tender, puffy — and no diet reaches it, because it was never fat; the tablet turns a glass of water into hydrogen-rich water, hydrogen is the smallest molecule there is, reaches the tissue and helps the body switch that process off so normal drainage can resume
strategy.sub_avatar: trigger: sucking in his gut for the family photo · cause: a bloated belly no diet moved · tried: cutting beer, crunches, 'it's just your age'
strategy.belief_installed: A belly that no diet moves isn't food I stored — it's what my body stopped clearing.
